The method `org.apache.commons.lang3.ClassUtils.toClass(Object[])` takes an array of objects, retrieves the class of each object in the array, and returns an array of corresponding classes. If the input array is null, it returns null. If the input array is empty, it returns an empty class array.

Given the failing test case `org.apache.commons.lang3.ClassUtilsTest.testToClass_object()` and the current bug report stating that `toClass(Object[])` throws a `NullPointerException` on a null array element, we can infer that the issue might be related to handling null elements within the input array.
Let's now proceed with fault localization.

messages.content:
" *

Adds all the elements of the given arrays into a new array.

*

The new array contains all of the element of array1 followed * by all of the elements array2. When an array is returned, it is always * a new array.

* * 
     * ArrayUtils.addAll(null, null)     = null
     * ArrayUtils.addAll(array1, null)   = cloned copy of array1
     * ArrayUtils.addAll(null, array2)   = cloned copy of array2
     * ArrayUtils.addAll([], [])         = []
     * ArrayUtils.addAll([null], [null]) = [null, null]
     * ArrayUtils.addAll(["a", "b", "c"], ["1", "2", "3"]) = ["a", "b", "c", "1", "2", "3"]
     *
* * @param array1 the first array whose elements are added to the new array, may be null * @param array2 the second array whose elements are added to the new array, may be null * @return The new array, null if both arrays are null. * The type of the new array is the type of the first array, * unless the first array is null, in which case the type is the same as the second array. * @since 2.1 * @throws IllegalArgumentException if the array types are incompatible "

The method `org.apache.commons.lang3.ArrayUtils.addAll(T[], T...)` adds all elements of the given arrays into a new array. The new array contains all elements of `array1` followed by all elements of `array2`. The type of the new array is determined by the type of the first array unless the first array is null, in which case the type is the same as the second array. If both input arrays are null, the method returns null.

This information about `ArrayUtils.addAll` might be useful for understanding how arrays are combined and handled in the Apache Commons Lang library. Let's continue with the fault localization.
